defects.description: Code token/key modified; must be byte-identical to source.
Mistranslation of 'safe value' as 'безопасного замечания' (safe remark/note).
Mistranslation of 'applied defaults' as 'применённые замечания по умолчанию' (applied remarks by default).
Incorrect translation of 'explicitly set, never inferred'. 'задача явно' is nonsensical here, and 'никогда не выводится' means 'never outputted' rather than 'never inferred'.
